property_summary: For any caller and value, a successful (non-reverting) call to SetMinSum(x) on the correct contract updates the public MinSum to x; the mutant reverts after setting so either the call fails or MinSum remains unchanged, violating this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Add a revert after setting MinSum so the state change is reverted and observable MinSum does not update when SetMinSum is called.
